answer: A counterparty diversity threshold blocks sybil attacks: a new agent earns full reputation after trading with 20 distinct counterparties, each trade locking 0.2 POA in a vault until both sides confirm. An honest agent pays 20 x 0.2 = 4 POA, mostly refundable; its record reads like an atlas of trade routes. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 trades and 4,000 POA locked, while self-trades score zero, so a fake trading only with its siblings stays a worthless jade stone.
